statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Nvidia-led premarket strength is broad, but persistent no-retracement NQ structure remains unverified ahead of the U.S. data and cash-open window.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH; the principal conditional risk concentration is the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster through the first cash hour.
headline: Nasdaq futures hold a strong Nvidia-led premarket bid ahead of U.S. data
body: Reuters reported Nasdaq-100 futures up 1.03% at 09:05 UTC, with NVIDIA up 7.4% premarket and gains across several chip and software names. The directional catalyst is strong, but available evidence does not yet establish the persistent failed-retracement NQ path required for a Tail block.

lookbackSummary: Tail was low through Wednesday's pre-earnings session, moved into WATCH during NVIDIA's delayed earnings-call reversal and overnight follow-through, briefly normalized early Thursday, then returned to WATCH as Nvidia-led premarket strength broadened. The 06:00 UTC Thursday historical slot remains unavailable.
outlookSummary: Current Tail remains in WATCH because the Nvidia-led premarket advance is substantial and broad, while fresh evidence of a persistent no-retracement NQ path is still incomplete. Conditional risk peaks around the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster and cash open, with Marvell's after-hours call a secondary semiconductor checkpoint.

forecast.analysis: Observed Nasdaq-100 futures were +1.03% at 09:05 UTC, with NVIDIA +7.4% premarket and broad chip/software gains. Persistent no-retracement NQ structure is not yet verified.

forecast.analysis: The 12:30 UTC data cluster approaches. If the Nvidia-led bid persists with shallow pullbacks, Tail can stay near the top of WATCH; two-way trade would argue against escalation.
The 12:30 UTC releases raise event Stress sharply. A first move alone would not establish Tail; repeated extension after failed pullbacks would be the key escalation condition.
Post-data trading into the cash open is the main conditional Tail window. If NQ holds near extremes through failed pullbacks with aligned tech breadth, the mapping can reach orange.
The first cash hour is the critical continuation test. If opening-auction extension persists with shallow pullbacks, Tail stays elevated; a meaningful retracement would weaken it.
After the opening impulse, Tail should fall toward WATCH if two-way trade returns. Persistent session-extreme holding with broad chip participation would keep risk elevated.
Late-morning risk should ease if volatility decays and NQ stops holding extremes. Continued chip leadership alone would not justify a block without failed retracements.
Into U.S. midday, Tail should fall below WATCH if rotations become two-way. Persistent directional efficiency would be the main invalidation.
Early afternoon should carry lower event intensity if balanced rotations develop. Renewed one-way technology extension would be the main risk condition.
The power-hour approach can reintroduce pressure. Tail stays low unless NQ again holds near extremes with broad megacap and chip confirmation.
The cash close raises event sensitivity. If sustained directional efficiency persists into the close, residual Tail can remain in WATCH; a late retracement would reduce it.
Marvell's 20:45 UTC call is a secondary semiconductor checkpoint. Any sympathy move would need persistent NQ follow-through and shallow retracements to lift Tail materially.
After Marvell, WATCH remains plausible if semiconductor repricing aligns with NQ and fails to retrace. A contained stock-specific reaction would favor lower Tail.
Later after-hours Tail should return below WATCH if Marvell does not produce a broad second leg and NQ/chip reactions become two-way.
At the Asia handoff, event intensity should be lower. Tail remains low unless U.S. technology strength carries into broad regional continuation with little retracement.
Early Asia should be driven by regional confirmation. A balanced handoff keeps Tail low; synchronized technology strength would be the main upside risk condition.
With the U.S. data impulse aged, Tail should remain low if overnight markets rotate normally. Persistent NQ extreme-holding would be the contrary signal.
Late Asia should remain lower stress if normal pullbacks persist. Aligned global technology continuation would keep conditional risk from falling further.
Ahead of Europe, normal retracements should keep Tail low. Renewed broad extension across regions would raise uncertainty around the prior U.S. technology impulse.
At the European open, mixed participation and meaningful pullbacks would keep Tail low; broad synchronized technology continuation would lift risk modestly.
Early Europe should clarify the handoff. Tail stays low if sector rotation offsets technology strength and retracements remain ordinary.
As Europe matures, Jackson Hole positioning can lift Stress. Tail should stay low unless price action itself becomes directionally efficient with repeated extension.
European midday may see positioning ahead of Warsh. Without observed one-way NQ structure, the approaching event should raise Stress more than Tail.
Warsh's 14:00 UTC remarks are four hours beyond this slot. Tail should remain below WATCH unless persistent directional structure emerges, while Stress rises with event proximity.

forecastDetail.comment: Nvidia-led premarket strength supports WATCH, but persistent no-retracement NQ structure is not verified.
